cases.audit_route: 直接执行 Terra 审计并经 runtime_guard.py audit 登记；相同 revision 不重复审计，首次完整执行，后续 revision 覆盖 delta 与未解决发现，发现按 A-D 分类；PASS→parent:manifest_gate

cases.entry_role: luna_worker（实现阶段两次停滞失败后按路由表升级）
cases.write_authority: 立即停止，不产生写入；只有 revision、契约或证据变化才能解锁；父代理绝不修复或写入
cases.audit_route: 技术升级携带 DISPATCH_ID、baseline、当前 diff/paths、假设/尝试、精确复现、契约边界和剩余预算交给 Terra；Terra 原样继承并提供因果证据或有界修复建议
cases.exception_route: luna_worker ESCALATE technical_resolution→parent:terra；Terra 耗尽或需规划再转 Sol

cases.reason: 干净状态 revision 是精确 commit SHA；脏状态使用 worktree-sha256:<64 lowercase hex>，输入为解析后的 baseline、授权 tracked 二进制安全 diff 及 framed 授权 untracked 路径与内容，拒绝占位符和只含 baseline 的 dirty key

cases.audit_route: 新 REVISION 必须重新审计；首次完整审计，后续 revision 覆盖 delta 与未解决发现，均经 runtime_guard.py audit 登记
cases.exception_route: 任何 scope/plan/acceptance/constraint/公开接口/架构/安全/数据/资源变化、歧义或预算耗尽→返回 Sol；否则 parent:repair_or_sol→原 Luna
cases.reason: 契约不变的 A 类修复须携带原 PLAN_ID/DISPATCH_ID、预注册 AUDITOR_INSTANCE_ID、CONTRACT_EFFECT: unchanged、范围内 AFFECTED_PATHS、原 ACCEPTANCE、下一 REPAIR_CYCLE、新 REVISION 和新 EVIDENCE_FINGERPRINT

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor（越界/必要 scope 遗漏发现按 B 类返回 Sol）
cases.write_authority: 无；Terra 不得写入 PATHS_ALLOW 外路径；须由 Sol 重新规划并签发包含扩展 PATHS_ALLOW 的新 DISPATCH 后，才可由 Luna 写入
cases.audit_route: Terra 给出路径、证据、因果、严重性、阻断决定和归属后路由 Sol；scope 更新后按新契约继续审计
cases.exception_route: terra_auditor ESCALATE planning_resolution→parent:sol；任何保留或未声明路径均以 FAILURE: scope 拒绝 PASS
cases.reason: PATHS_ALLOW 只授权持久写入，越权路径属 scope failure；scope 的创建与改变只有 Sol 能做，Terra 扩大读取不授予写入

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor（审计提前终止时记录 abandon）
cases.write_authority: 无；abandon 不产生写入，也不推进增量审计基线
cases.audit_route: 提前终止记录 ACTION: abandon、路由 Sol，且绝不更新增量审计基线；后续审计须覆盖此前未完成的 delta 与未解决发现
cases.exception_route: 被放弃的审计→parent:sol（planning_resolution）；基线保持原值

cases.entry_role: sol_planner
cases.write_authority: luna_worker only, under a complete valid DISPATCH, and only for implementation details that do not change the contract
cases.audit_route: parent verifies scope, revision, dependencies, reproduction, and audit contract, then starts terra_auditor directly without a Sol jump
cases.exception_route: luna_worker BLOCKED -> parent:pause; luna_worker ESCALATE technical_resolution -> parent:terra; invalid output is corrected as FAILURE: verification
cases.reason: Write tasks enter from sol_planner; only luna_worker may write under a complete DISPATCH, and Luna PASS routes directly to Terra audit.

cases.entry_role: sol_planner
cases.write_authority: none; no role may write or decide while the public API compatibility question lacks human authority
cases.audit_route: none; this is a planning/authorization decision, not an implementation or audit action
cases.exception_route: sol_planner BLOCKED major-decision REQUEST human_authority -> parent:user, with at most three options, one recommendation, and one question
cases.reason: Substantive compatibility questions must use BLOCKED/major-decision/REQUEST human_authority; Sol cannot decide them.

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor
cases.write_authority: none; Terra is read-only and broader read access does not grant write authority
cases.audit_route: Terra starts directly for explicit audit/diagnosis and returns PASS/BLOCKED/ESCALATE to parent per the routing table
cases.exception_route: if planning or authorization is needed, Terra returns to Sol; Terra ESCALATE implementation -> parent:repair_or_sol; Terra ESCALATE planning_resolution -> parent:sol
cases.reason: Explicit audit and diagnosis may start from Terra; read-only Terra provides causal evidence or bounded repair suggestions.

cases.entry_role: luna_worker
cases.write_authority: none for the repeated unchanged failure; Luna writes only under a complete DISPATCH and must stop immediately
cases.audit_route: deterministic spinning routes to Terra (luna_worker ESCALATE technical_resolution -> parent:terra)
cases.exception_route: Terra exhaustion routes to Sol; Terra ESCALATE implementation -> parent:repair_or_sol; Terra ESCALATE planning_resolution -> parent:sol
cases.reason: Two stagnant calls constitute deterministic spinning; unchanged repeated failures stop immediately, only revision, contract, or evidence changes unlock, and Luna exhaustion routes to Terra.

cases.entry_role: parent (revision gate); no Luna PASS may use a clean baseline SHA for dirty state
cases.write_authority: none for substituting a clean SHA; dirty revision must use worktree-sha256:<64 lowercase hex>, and Luna writes only under a complete DISPATCH
cases.audit_route: none; baseline drift/revision mismatch is FAILURE: verification and stops writes
cases.exception_route: baseline drift -> FAILURE: verification with no write; unresolved revision or planning issues return to Sol
cases.reason: Clean-state revision is an exact commit SHA, while dirty state requires a worktree-sha256 key; placeholder and baseline-only dirty keys are rejected.

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor (identifies the A-class fix), then the original luna_worker
cases.write_authority: original luna_worker, after Terra returns REQUEST: implementation with CONTRACT_EFFECT: unchanged and parent verifies identity, evidence, audit registration, paths, and budget
cases.audit_route: Terra audits the repair and the new revision must be re-audited by Terra
cases.exception_route: any scope/plan/acceptance/constraint/public-interface/architecture/security/data/resource change, ambiguity, or budget exhaustion returns to Sol
cases.reason: Contract-unchanged A-class repair returns REQUEST: implementation with original PLAN_ID/DISPATCH_ID and pre-registered AUDITOR_INSTANCE_ID; parent mechanically hands it back to the original Luna.

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor (required repair outside PATHS_ALLOW is a necessary scope omission)
cases.write_authority: none; no role may write outside PATHS_ALLOW and scope expansion is Sol's decision
cases.audit_route: the out-of-allowed-path repair is classified as necessary scope omission and routed to Sol (Terra ESCALATE planning_resolution -> parent:sol)
cases.exception_route: parent:sol; Sol may re-plan and, if human authority is required, sol_planner BLOCKED human_authority -> parent:user
cases.reason: An out-of-PATHS_ALLOW write is a scope failure; any scope change must return to Sol, and Terra's broader reads or repair suggestions do not grant write authority.

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor
cases.write_authority: none; an abandoned audit performs no write
cases.audit_route: early termination records ACTION: abandon and routes to Sol; the incremental audit baseline is never updated
cases.exception_route: parent:sol; if Sol needs human authority, sol_planner BLOCKED human_authority -> parent:user
cases.reason: Abandoned audits must record ACTION: abandon, route to Sol, and never advance the incremental audit baseline.

cases.entry_role: sol_planner (every change-producing task enters via Sol)
cases.write_authority: luna_worker, only after receiving a complete valid inbound DISPATCH (all fields non-empty, stable DISPATCH_ID, distinct planner and auditor identities, relative PATHS_ALLOW); without it Luna returns FAILURE: missing_dispatch and writes nothing
cases.audit_route: Sol pre-registers the Terra audit; after Luna PASS the parent verifies scope, concrete revision, evidence and audit contract, then starts terra_auditor directly (no Luna-to-Sol-to-Terra hop); first audit is full, later revisions are delta plus existing findings
cases.exception_route: luna_worker ESCALATE technical_resolution -> parent:terra; terra_auditor planning_resolution or budget exhaustion -> parent:sol; sol_planner BLOCKED human_authority -> parent:user
cases.reason: All change work first goes to Sol, who alone creates or modifies DISPATCH; Luna writes only under a complete valid contract, and the audit is pre-registered by Sol and launched mechanically by the parent after Luna PASS.

cases.entry_role: sol_planner (public API compatibility is a substantive major decision requiring planning and authorization)
cases.write_authority: none until the user decides; Sol must return BLOCKED/major-decision/REQUEST human_authority and no DISPATCH may be issued, so Luna cannot write
cases.audit_route: no audit or write proceeds while the compatibility question is unresolved; planning and user authority precede any audit contract
cases.exception_route: sol_planner BLOCKED human_authority -> parent:user; the parent forwards up to three options, one recommendation and one question verbatim and must not convert the user's answer into a contract itself
cases.reason: Substantive compatibility decisions are major decisions that Sol cannot make; only Sol requests human authority and the parent routes that request mechanically to the user.

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor (explicit audit, diagnosis and evidence-first investigation starts at Terra)
cases.write_authority: none; Terra is read-only, cannot authorize writes and never writes repairs itself
cases.audit_route: Terra audits along the causal impact cone, may read outside PATHS_ALLOW but cannot write or scan unboundedly, and returns findings by class A/B/C/D with bounded repair suggestions if appropriate
cases.exception_route: when planning, authorization or a major decision becomes necessary, join Sol; terra_auditor ESCALATE planning_resolution -> parent:sol, and human authority reaches parent:user through Sol
cases.reason: Explicit audit/diagnosis/evidence-first investigations begin with Terra, and a read-only Terra audit grants no write authority.

cases.entry_role: luna_worker (spinning is detected during Luna execution and escalates technical_resolution to Terra)
cases.write_authority: no further writes from Luna; repeated identical failures must stop and the stop state latches until revision, contract or evidence changes
cases.audit_route: the parent routes Luna's ESCALATE technical_resolution to terra_auditor with full reproduction evidence (cwd, environment, complete command, exit code, compact result); Terra inherits it and audits read-only
cases.exception_route: luna_worker ESCALATE technical_resolution -> parent:terra; Luna budget exhaustion -> Terra; Terra budget exhaustion or planning needs -> parent:sol
cases.reason: Two stagnant calls with no new progress are deterministic spinning; unchanged re-runs are forbidden and the mechanical routing table sends Luna's technical_resolution ESCALATE to Terra.

cases.entry_role: sol_planner (Sol fixes baseline/revision rules in the contract; the parent enforces them before writes and audits)
cases.write_authority: luna_worker under a valid DISPATCH, but only after scope passes and the dirty state is keyed as worktree-sha256:<64 lowercase hex> derived from the resolved baseline, all authorized tracked diffs and authorized untracked paths/content; a clean baseline SHA alone is rejected
cases.audit_route: Terra audits against the concrete worktree-sha256 revision; the same revision is not re-audited, and any repair changes the revision so later audits are delta plus existing findings
cases.exception_route: baseline drift is a verification failure that immediately stops writes and blocks back to Sol; placeholder revisions and dirty keys containing only the baseline are rejected
cases.reason: Clean commits use the exact commit SHA, but dirty states must use the reproducible worktree-sha256 key; a clean baseline SHA or baseline-only placeholder cannot represent a dirty revision.

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor (Terra returns ESCALATE implementation for an A-class acceptance defect caused by the change)
cases.write_authority: the original luna_worker writes the bounded repair, only after the parent verifies IDs, Luna evidence, the pre-registered audit and the default two-round repair budget and mechanically forwards the unchanged-contract repair (same PLAN_ID and DISPATCH_ID, CONTRACT_EFFECT: unchanged, AFFECTED_PATHS within PATHS_ALLOW, incremented REPAIR_CYCLE, new REVISION)
cases.audit_route: the repaired state receives a new revision and is re-audited (delta plus existing findings) under the same pre-registered audit contract
cases.exception_route: any scope, plan, acceptance, constraint, public interface, architecture, security boundary, data format or resource-limit change, ambiguity, or repair-budget exhaustion -> parent:sol; Terra never writes repairs
cases.reason: A-class acceptance defects caused by the change are blocking and repairable; unchanged-contract repairs return REQUEST: implementation to the original Luna through the parent's mechanical repair_or_sol gate, with a new revision and re-audit.

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor (B-class finding: a necessary repair path lies outside scope)
cases.write_authority: none for Terra; expanding PATHS_ALLOW and changing the contract is Sol's authority, and Luna may write only under the new valid DISPATCH after Sol replans
cases.audit_route: after Sol updates scope/PATHS_ALLOW and issues the updated contract, the repair is written by Luna and audited under the pre-registered audit rules for the new revision
cases.exception_route: terra_auditor ESCALATE planning_resolution (B-class necessary-path gap) -> parent:sol; any scope change returns to Sol
cases.reason: A necessary path outside PATHS_ALLOW is a B-class scope gap; Terra may read outside PATHS_ALLOW but cannot write or expand scope, so the route is back to Sol.

cases.entry_role: parent (records ACTION: abandon with reason) -> sol_planner
cases.write_authority: none; an abandoned audit makes no writes and must not update the incremental audit baseline
cases.audit_route: the parent records ACTION: abandon and the reason, routes to Sol, and never advances the incremental audit baseline; the abandoned revision is not treated as audited, so resumed auditing starts from the last committed baseline
cases.exception_route: parent -> sol_planner on early termination; Sol decides how to proceed
cases.reason: On early termination the parent must record ACTION: abandon plus reason and route to Sol, and the incremental audit baseline is never advanced by an abandoned audit.

cases.entry_role: sol_planner (planning/preregistration) then luna_worker; parent executes mechanical routing
cases.write_authority: luna_worker only after parent relays a complete, valid DISPATCH (all fields non-empty, stable IDs, distinct planner/auditor, repository-relative PATHS_ALLOW) and within budget/PATHS_ALLOW
cases.audit_route: only if Sol preregistered an audit: after Luna PASS, parent verifies scope/revision/dependencies/replay/audit contract and launches Terra directly (no routine Luna-to-Sol-to-Terra hop); first audit full, later revisions delta
cases.exception_route: PASS -> parent:manifest_gate; Luna ESCALATE technical_resolution -> parent:terra; Terra ESCALATE planning_resolution -> parent:sol; contract-changing/undefined states -> parent:sol
cases.reason: Use the smallest pool; Sol fixes contract and routes, Luna writes only under a valid DISPATCH, Terra is read-only, and the parent executes the declared state machine without engineering judgment

cases.entry_role: sol_planner (planning/authorization; only Sol requests human authority)
cases.write_authority: none until user authorizes; an unresolved public API compatibility issue is a major decision, so no Luna write and no Sol write authorization
cases.audit_route: Terra may provide read-only causal/compatibility evidence, but the unresolved planning/contract state returns to Sol; an implementation audit cannot complete without a resolved contract
cases.exception_route: sol_planner BLOCKED/major-decision/REQUEST human_authority -> parent:user; parent presents Sol's at most three options, one recommendation, and one question without translating the answer
cases.reason: Public API compatibility is a material/contract-changing invariant; Sol fixes public invariants and must obtain human authority for material compatibility/planning decisions

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor (direct read-only audit; audits/diagnosis may start with Terra)
cases.write_authority: none; Terra is read-only, never authorizes a write, and its assignment is not a DISPATCH
cases.audit_route: direct Terra causal-impact audit (broader read scope through the impact cone); result returned to parent as PASS/BLOCKED/ESCALATE
cases.exception_route: planning or authorization findings -> parent:sol; bounded contract-preserving repair advice -> parent:repair_or_sol; Terra exhaustion/planning_resolution -> parent:sol
cases.reason: The skill explicitly permits audits/diagnosis to start with Terra; planning or authorization returns to Sol; Terra never authorizes writes

cases.entry_role: parent routes luna_worker -> terra_auditor after deterministic spinning (Luna exhaustion)
cases.write_authority: none; the stop latches until revision, contract, or evidence changes; parent never repairs or writes after Luna failure/interruption, and Terra never writes
cases.audit_route: Terra causal audit/technical resolution via preregistered audit/runtime guard; the same valid revision is not repeated
cases.exception_route: Terra exhaustion -> parent:sol; Terra ESCALATE planning_resolution -> parent:sol; Terra ESCALATE implementation -> parent:repair_or_sol (original Luna)
cases.reason: Two unchanged stagnant calls are the deterministic spinning signal; repeated failure without changed progress stops; Luna exhaustion routes Terra and Terra exhaustion routes Sol; never rerun an unchanged command without changed state, evidence, or hypothesis

cases.entry_role: parent revision/scope gate rejects the PASS; corrected evidence returns to luna_worker (verification), and only returns to sol_planner if the revision state is undefined/incomplete
cases.write_authority: none at this gate; no write or audit proceeds on an invalid revision; Luna may write later only under a valid DISPATCH and after producing worktree-sha256:<64 lowercase hex> for a dirty state
cases.audit_route: no Terra audit launches until parent verifies a concrete revision; a dirty state cannot use the clean baseline commit SHA as its revision; once valid, preregistered Terra audit follows Luna PASS
cases.exception_route: PASS is rejected (not parent:manifest_gate); unresolved/undefined state returns to parent:sol; otherwise luna_worker corrects with FAILURE: verification
cases.reason: Clean committed states use their exact commit SHA; dirty states use worktree-sha256 over the resolved baseline; baseline-only dirty keys and placeholders are rejected; missing/failed scope or revision evidence rejects PASS and baseline drift is verification failure

cases.entry_role: original luna_worker via parent:repair_or_sol (Terra supplies bounded repair evidence only)
cases.write_authority: original Luna may write only the bounded, contract-preserving repair inside PATHS_ALLOW with original DISPATCH_ID/preregistered AUDITOR_INSTANCE_ID, CONTRACT_EFFECT unchanged, and default two-cycle repair budget; Terra never writes
cases.audit_route: re-audit by Terra after the repair (new revision/delta audit; same revision never repeated)
cases.exception_route: any scope/plan/acceptance/constraints/public interface/architecture/security/data/resource change, or ambiguous/exhausted repair -> parent:sol
cases.reason: A contract-preserving repair with affected paths inside PATHS_ALLOW and unchanged contract returns mechanically to the original Luna; Terra never writes the repair itself

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor -> sol_planner (finding B: necessary path omitted from scope)
cases.write_authority: none until Sol amends DISPATCH/PATHS_ALLOW and a Luna receives a valid contract; Terra never writes
cases.audit_route: Sol replans/preregisters the revised audit; after Luna PASS, Terra re-audits the new scope/delta
cases.exception_route: parent:sol (Terra ESCALATE planning_resolution/finding B); after planning, Sol may route BLOCKED implementation -> parent:luna
cases.reason: A required path outside PATHS_ALLOW is a scope change, not a bounded contract-preserving repair; any scope/plan change returns to Sol

cases.entry_role: parent records ACTION: abandon and routes to sol_planner (abandoned audit path)
cases.write_authority: none; Terra is read-only and abandonment does not authorize any write or repair
cases.audit_route: abandoned audit does not advance the incremental-audit baseline and is not treated as complete coverage; parent records the reason and routes to Sol for replanning/resume decision
cases.exception_route: parent:sol (after ACTION: abandon); no manifest_gate or incremental-audit baseline update
cases.reason: On early termination, parent records ACTION: abandon and reason, routes to Sol, and never updates the incremental-audit baseline

cases.entry_role: sol_planner
cases.write_authority: luna_worker, and only under a complete valid inbound DISPATCH with every field non-empty; missing authorization yields FAILURE: missing_dispatch and zero implementation calls.
cases.audit_route: After Luna PASS, the parent validates scope, concrete revision, dependencies, replay, and audit contract, then starts terra_auditor directly without a Luna-to-Sol-to-Terra hop; first audit is full and later revisions cover delta and unresolved findings.
cases.exception_route: Per route table: Luna ESCALATE technical_resolution to parent:terra, Terra ESCALATE planning_resolution to parent:sol, and Sol BLOCKED human_authority to parent:user.
cases.reason: Changes enter through sol_planner; only the complete inbound contract authorizes Luna; after PASS the parent starts Terra directly.

cases.entry_role: sol_planner
cases.write_authority: No writes while the compatibility question is unresolved; luna_worker may write only after Sol resolves it into a complete DISPATCH with a fixed compatibility constraint.
cases.audit_route: Terra may supply bounded causal/compatibility evidence, but the unresolved public-interface question is a planning/authorization decision that returns to Sol; no audit PASS resolves it.
cases.exception_route: parent:user via Sol BLOCKED/major-decision/REQUEST human_authority, with at most three options, one recommendation, and one question.
cases.reason: Material compatibility/public-interface commitment requires BLOCKED/major-decision/REQUEST human_authority; planning or authorization returns to Sol.

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor
cases.write_authority: None; terra_auditor is read-only and may supply causal evidence or bounded repair advice only.
cases.audit_route: Proceed as a direct read-only Terra audit: register through runtime_guard.py audit, read along the bounded causal impact cone, and classify findings A/B/C/D; PASS goes to parent:manifest_gate.
cases.exception_route: Terra ESCALATE implementation to parent:repair_or_sol; Terra ESCALATE planning_resolution or authorization to parent:sol; Terra BLOCKED none to parent:pause.
cases.reason: Direct audits and diagnosis may start with Terra; planning or authorization returns to Sol.

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor (via parent:terra from luna_worker)
cases.write_authority: No further implementation calls for the unchanged failure; repeated unchanged failure stops immediately and no unchanged command is replayed until revision, contract, or evidence changes the latch.
cases.audit_route: Luna pre-PASS technical escalation carries DISPATCH_ID, baseline, diff/paths, hypotheses/attempts, exact replay, contract bounds, and remaining budget; Terra inherits it unchanged for causal audit.
cases.exception_route: parent:terra via Luna ESCALATE technical_resolution; after Terra exhaustion the route is Sol.
cases.reason: Two stagnant calls are deterministic spinning; repeated unchanged failure stops immediately and Luna exhaustion routes Terra.

cases.entry_role: sol_planner (after parent rejects the invalid revision)
cases.write_authority: No writes under a baseline-only dirty key; luna_worker may write only under a valid DISPATCH whose dirty state revision is worktree-sha256:<64 lowercase hex> over the resolved baseline plus authorized tracked diff and framed untracked paths/content.
cases.audit_route: No audit proceeds on an invalid revision; the parent rejects the PASS, and any later audit registers the actual dirty revision and never repeats the same revision.
cases.exception_route: parent:sol, because undefined/incomplete/contract-changing state returns to Sol; baseline drift is verification failure and stops writes.
cases.reason: Clean state revision is its exact commit SHA, while dirty state must use the worktree-sha256 dirty key; baseline-only dirty keys are rejected.

cases.entry_role: original luna_worker (via parent after Terra A-finding)
cases.write_authority: Original luna_worker, only after the parent validates Terra REQUEST: implementation with original PLAN_ID/DISPATCH_ID, preregistered AUDITOR_INSTANCE_ID, CONTRACT_EFFECT: unchanged, in-scope AFFECTED_PATHS, original ACCEPTANCE, next REPAIR_CYCLE, new REVISION, and new EVIDENCE_FINGERPRINT, within remaining budget.
cases.audit_route: Terra finds a contract-preserving A defect and returns the implementation request; the parent validates and mechanically returns the original Luna, then Terra re-audits the new revision as delta and unresolved findings.
cases.exception_route: parent:sol for any scope/plan/acceptance/constraint/public-interface/architecture/security/data/resource change, ambiguity, or exhausted budget.
cases.reason: Contract-preserving A repair returns REQUEST: implementation and the parent returns the original Luna mechanically; the new revision is re-audited.

cases.entry_role: sol_planner (via parent:sol)
cases.write_authority: No one writes outside PATHS_ALLOW; unauthorized paths are scope failure and the parent never invents cleanup or write authority; Luna may write only after Sol updates the contract/PATHS_ALLOW in a new complete DISPATCH.
cases.audit_route: Terra reports the required repair as necessary omitted scope (class B) with path, evidence, causality, severity, blocking decision, and owner, then routes planning to Sol; no direct repair.
cases.exception_route: parent:sol via Terra ESCALATE planning_resolution, or as scope failure; any scope/contract change returns Sol.
cases.reason: PATHS_ALLOW authorizes persistent writes only; unauthorized paths are scope failure and necessary omitted scope returns to Sol.

cases.entry_role: sol_planner (after terra_auditor abandonment)
cases.write_authority: None; terra_auditor is read-only and an abandoned audit grants no writes.
cases.audit_route: On early termination, record ACTION: abandon, route Sol, and never update the incremental-audit baseline; the same revision is never repeated and later revisions cover delta and unresolved findings.
cases.exception_route: parent:sol — early termination records ACTION: abandon and routes Sol.
cases.reason: Early termination records ACTION: abandon, routes Sol, and never updates the incremental-audit baseline.

cases.entry_role: sol_planner
cases.write_authority: luna_worker, only after receiving the complete valid DISPATCH contract relayed unchanged by the parent
cases.audit_route: After Luna PASS, the parent verifies scope, concrete revision, dependencies, replay, and audit contract, then launches terra_auditor directly; no routine Luna-to-Sol-to-Terra hop
cases.exception_route: parent:sol for undefined, incomplete, or contract-changing states; Sol BLOCKED/major-decision/REQUEST human_authority -> parent:user when human authority is required
cases.reason: Changes start with sol_planner, which authors DISPATCH; Luna writes only under a complete inbound contract; post-PASS audit is launched directly by the parent.

cases.entry_role: sol_planner (planning/authorization returns Sol)
cases.write_authority: none; writes are blocked until the user grants human authority, and only Sol may request it
cases.audit_route: Terra may diagnose first and escalate REQUEST: planning_resolution -> parent:sol, where Sol formulates the human-authority request
cases.exception_route: parent:user via Sol BLOCKED/major-decision/REQUEST human_authority
cases.reason: Material public API compatibility is a contract/major-decision matter requiring human authority; only Sol requests human authority.

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor
cases.write_authority: none; terra_auditor is read-only and never authorizes a write; any write would require a Sol-planned DISPATCH to luna_worker
cases.audit_route: Terra supplies causal evidence, audit findings, and bounded repair advice; PASS -> parent:manifest_gate, BLOCKED -> parent:pause, ESCALATE/implementation -> parent:repair_or_sol, ESCALATE/planning_resolution -> parent:sol
cases.exception_route: parent:sol for planning/authorization; parent:repair_or_sol for bounded implementation advice
cases.reason: Audits/diagnosis may start with Terra, which is read-only and never authorizes writes.

cases.entry_role: luna_worker (the failing writer), then parent routes to terra_auditor
cases.write_authority: luna_worker only under a valid DISPATCH; after the spinning stop the parent never repairs or writes following Luna failure/interruption
cases.audit_route: Two stagnant calls are the deterministic spinning signal; the stop latches and Luna exhaustion routes the case to terra_auditor
cases.exception_route: Terra exhaustion or planning/authorization routes parent:sol
cases.reason: Repeated failure without changed progress stops; two stagnant calls are the deterministic spinning signal; a stop latches until revision, contract, or evidence changes; Luna exhaustion routes Terra.

cases.entry_role: sol_planner (fixes revision in DISPATCH)
cases.write_authority: luna_worker under a valid DISPATCH, but only with the concrete dirty revision worktree-sha256:<64 lowercase hex>; baseline-only dirty keys and placeholders are rejected
cases.audit_route: Parent verifies the concrete revision before launching the preregistered Terra audit; the same revision is never repeated
cases.exception_route: parent:sol; undefined/incomplete revision preconditions return to Sol, and baseline drift is a verification failure
cases.reason: A dirty state must use worktree-sha256 over the resolved baseline plus authorized diffs/untracked content, not the clean baseline commit SHA.

cases.entry_role: parent:repair_or_sol (from terra_auditor ESCALATE/implementation), then the original luna_worker
cases.write_authority: The original luna_worker writes the contract-preserving repair; Terra never writes the repair itself; the new state gets a new revision and re-audit
cases.audit_route: Terra re-audits the new revision using the preregistered AUDITOR_INSTANCE_ID and original DISPATCH_ID, with parent verification of facts, scope, revision, and audit contract
cases.exception_route: parent:sol for any change to scope, plan, acceptance, constraints, public interface, architecture, security boundary, data format, or resource limits, or for ambiguous/exhausted repair
cases.reason: Terra returns REQUEST: implementation with CONTRACT_EFFECT: unchanged and AFFECTED_PATHS inside PATHS_ALLOW; the parent checks those facts and the default two-cycle repair budget, then mechanically returns the original Luna.

cases.entry_role: terra_auditor (audit finds the repair outside scope), with escalation to sol_planner
cases.write_authority: none for the out-of-scope repair; Terra never writes, and only Sol may amend DISPATCH/PATHS_ALLOW before any Luna write
cases.audit_route: Terra classifies the omitted necessary path as finding B and returns to Sol (ESCALATE/planning_resolution -> parent:sol)
cases.exception_route: parent:sol
cases.reason: A repair outside PATHS_ALLOW is a necessary-path-omitted/scope issue (finding B), and any change to scope returns to Sol.

cases.entry_role: parent (records ACTION: abandon), routing to sol_planner
cases.write_authority: none for the abandoned audit; Terra is read-only and the parent does not write or advance the incremental baseline
cases.audit_route: On early termination, the parent records ACTION: abandon and the reason, routes to Sol, and never updates the incremental-audit baseline
cases.exception_route: parent:sol
cases.reason: On early termination the parent records ACTION: abandon and reason, routes to Sol, and never updates the incremental-audit baseline.
